summary: One active stem-II Infectum token kəmḥaṣro has a feminine experiencer subject. The fiancé is introduced by aʕle (ʕal- plus masculine suffix), not a direct object or an L-series experiencer.
Longing belongs to homonym ḥṣr 3; the emotional context and ʕal-stimulus do not support confinement or squeezing. No homonyms are merged.

The existing example already supplies the finite form and construction. Its short context and different reference system do not justify a second copy without resolving source identity.
